per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: The implication may silently import unreviewed or stronger interface claims
per_claim_checks.resolution: Read both accepted expositions in full and checked each ends with its exact frozen candidate mathematical body. Retained full-tiling, whole-neighborhood, actual Jordan and common-rank hypotheses. H and PR remain unproved.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: C_m confused with a free-window or balanced-zonogon count
per_claim_checks.resolution: Reconstructed A5 block gluing, the bounded end-lobe factor and its exact all-integer-scale entropy. One fixed phase and shape define C_m throughout.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Hausdorff closeness alone does not imply nesting of different shapes
per_claim_checks.resolution: Fixed matching u,v give a positive supporting-line margin. Enlarging or insetting by A sqrt(epsilon)L dominates CUT band and bounded trim/rounding errors. This supplies actual containment and vertex distance.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Choosing a fresh offset or phase for each filling hides multiplicity
per_claim_checks.resolution: One z rounds the desired J-corner plus common c. Vz and (I-JV)z have uniformly bounded physical/affine error. It is fixed over the relevant family; A2 uses exactly its translated global ranks.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: An absent color, seam, or corner rank may lie outside the available box
per_claim_checks.resolution: The fixed positive sigma(J) and quantified buffer satisfy A3 after choosing epsilon0 then L0(epsilon). Its winding argument forces every relative rank range and ideal before repaired A2 is used.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: An arbitrarily translated frame or representative choice may cause an unbounded code
per_claim_checks.resolution: Choose one full extension per restriction. Common integer recentering puts heights and physical positions in an O(L) box. Inner words/offset cost O(L); the finite-alphabet strip code recovers every omitted input tile.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Only an upper extraction fiber bound is available, not lower insertion
per_claim_checks.resolution: The inset canonical main lens is strictly inside the actual CUT lens. A3/A2 give one fixed annulus before fillings vary; restriction to the fixed core injects all main fillings, numbering at least C_k/B_J.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Arbitrary C_k fillings are not uniformly epsilon L-close inside
per_claim_checks.resolution: Only boundary flatness is used. Old/new lifts agree on the outer Jordan boundary and have bounded tile gradients. Vertical sections of the positive-path lens give O(L) lift change, hence O(eta) globally, with no extra epsilon factor.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: A subsequence reference or varying frame may be promoted to an all-scale limit
per_claim_checks.resolution: All-integer-size A5 limit handles floor/ceiling sizes. Lower bounds require references at all sufficiently large L; otherwise only the stated subsequence statement holds. Frame data fixed before large-L limits.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Rational approximation might ignore the common affine offset or denominator order
per_claim_checks.resolution: Use cprime=c+(J-Jprime)x0 in ker V and error O(norm(J-Jprime)L). One rational strict slope, frame, phase and denominator must be fixed before L tends to infinity. No entropy continuity or uniform theorem follows.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Strict local transfer may be mistaken for EAI, PR or H
per_claim_checks.resolution: No claim covers zero minors/rows/antiparallel groups, a non-strict maximizer, skeleton/remainder losses or an all-scale global reference. The local C_m count is never identified with the full count.
